attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: সম্মানসূচক খেতাবধারী ব্যক্তি; আগে অশ্বারোহী অভিজাত।

definition.oewn_definition: originally a person of noble birth trained to arms and chivalry; today in Great Britain a person honored by the sovereign for personal merit
definition.text: originally a person of noble birth trained to arms and chivalry; today in Great Britain a person honored by the sovereign for personal merit

examples.en: The queen made the doctor a knight.

bangla_explanation.text: দাবার যে ঘুঁটি ঘোড়ার মাথার মতো এবং এল-আকারে চলে।

definition.oewn_definition: a chessman shaped to resemble the head of a horse; can move two squares horizontally and one vertically (or vice versa)
definition.text: a chessman shaped to resemble the head of a horse; can move two squares horizontally and one vertically (or vice versa)

examples.bn: তার দাবার ঘোড়া অরক্ষিত সিপাইকে খেল।
examples.en: Her knight captured the unprotected pawn.
